message.content: Build the manager-worker consensus negotiation protocol (`protocol.py`) so specialist worker agents iteratively repair statutory, daylight, circulation, Vastu and budget constraints after the committee vote.

content.thinking: Voting picks the best candidate in the pool but cannot fix a flaw shared by all candidates. A manager-worker negotiation loop that accepts worker repairs only when whole-plan re-measurement improves (weighting hard constraints 3x soft) guarantees monotonic improvement.

content.thinking: A house is only buildable if every room is reachable through rooms that allow through-traffic (never through a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or puja) and multi-storey plans stack their staircase and plumbing.
